name: 0.55 T whole-body MRI of obese, claustrophobic and paediatric patients in an 80 cm bore DryCool magnet operating on < 700 ml helium
plain_name: Scan large or anxious patients in an extra-wide low-helium MRI
description: Clinical MRI at 0.55 T in the MAGNETOM Free.Max 80 cm bore, for patients who cannot tolerate narrower bores and very heavy patients (320 kg table option); the superconducting DryCool magnet runs on < 700 ml of helium without a quench pipe.
keywords: Scan large or anxious patients in an extra-wide low-helium MRI

sources.citation: Siemens Healthineers, MAGNETOM Free.Max - Breaking barriers to expand the reach of MRI (flyer)

requirements.rationale: Imaging is performed at 0.55 T field strength.
The patient group (obese, severely claustrophobic) is defined by needing an 80 cm bore.
Very large patients need the 320 kg table load option.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
